As part of this change, all employees will be given access to the ‘My Time’ section of HR Organiser to report their sickness absence. If you are a line manager, you will be required to enter the employee’s absence on the first day they are off, even if they are a casual employee, as you currently do for your direct reports. Once the employee returns from sick leave, they will be required to add an end date to the period of absence. Please ensure you familiarise yourself with the sickness absence management policy below.
